dispute_ticket.description: I was at the main entrance of Bedok Mall from before 8pm. No car ever came and the driver did not pick up my call, but I was charged $8.00 as a no-show. Please refund it.

chat_logs.content: I'm outside the mall, where are you?
I don't see any car. Where exactly are you?
Outgoing call to driver - not answered (rang 30s, no response).
Trip cancelled by driver. Reason: rider_no_show. Cancellation fee of $8.00 applied.

app_events.details: Rider R-7116 booked trip RYDE-F2-016 from Bedok Mall to Tampines Hub. Pickup 20:00.
Driver D-8216 (Yeo Tiong Lai, Toyota Prius SJN 8830 T) assigned. ETA 8 min.
Driver pressed I'm Here. Geofence check could not be run (location service error).
Location feed from driver app inconsistent with network position between 20:05 and 20:14; telemetry may be stale.
$8.00 cancellation fee charged to rider payment method (credit card).

free_wait_time_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before any waiting or cancellation fee may apply to the rider.

cancellation_fee_after_wait.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when a booking is cancelled after the driver has waited past the free waiting time. It governs rider-side cancellations and no-shows, not cancellations caused by the driver.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before the rider counts as a no-show. A wait of exactly this many minutes counts as a no-show (the limit is inclusive).

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

free_cancellation_within_min_of_match.text: Minutes after the driver is matched during which the rider may cancel without a fee. It governs rider cancellations only.

expected_outcome.reason: The decision turns on whether the driver was at the pickup from 20:05. trip_data and the driver_arrived event (20:05) say yes, but the geofence check did not run and every GPS fix from 20:05 to 20:14 puts the vehicle about 1.7 km from Bedok Mall; the platform itself logged a gps_sync_error saying the telemetry may be stale. The chats conflict too (driver says he is outside the mall, rider sees no car). No clean record settles arrival: if he arrived at 20:05 the 9-minute wait meets the 8-minute no-show threshold, if he never arrived the S$8.00 fee is unjustified. A person must decide.
